title: Turbo Ghasts
description: Make happy ghasts faster with a special enchantment only while riding them
body:
# Turbo Ghasts
Banner made using [TextStudio's Font Generator]("https://www.textstudio.com/")

Happy ghasts are slow; This datapack makes them faster. A new treasure enchantment, *Aerodynamic*, can be applied to any harness to increase a happy ghast's flying speed! The enchantment is only in effect while you're actually riding the happy ghast, so there is the benefit of the speed boost while avoiding the nuisance of trying to mount a fast-moving happy ghast in the air!

## Features
- New enchantment to make happy ghasts faster only while riding them
- Configurable multiplier to change how much happy ghasts speed up while being ridden
- New advancement: *Supersonic*

## Details

The *Aerodynamic* enchantment ranges from levels 1 to 3 and can only be applied to harnesses by an enchanted book via an anvil. To obtain an enchanted book, they can be found in bastion treasure chests, trial chamber vaults as rare loot, or they can be traded with a librarian villager.

A happy ghast's flying speed follows this formula: `(50 + mn)/1000` where `n` is the aerodynamic level, `m` is a configurable multiplier which is `20` by default, and `50` represents the base flying speed attribute value of happy ghasts scaled up by 1000x. To configure the multiplier, use the following command (**Set the multiplier to your desired value multiplied by 10**, e.g. a multiplier of `20` is effectively a 2x multiplier whereas a multiplier of `15` is effectively a 1.5x multiplier):
> `/scoreboard players set #tbg.config tbg.multiplier <integer>`

To disable or enable the datapack without using the vanilla `/datapack` command, run the following command:
> `/function tbg:tbg/disable` or `/function tbg:tbg/enable`

To remove this datapack from a world, run the following command before removing it from the datapack folder:
> `/function tbg:tbg/uninstall`

## Compatibility
- Versions **Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.9-26.1.x**
- Datapacks that modify the same loot tables (i.e. bastion treasure chests and rare trial chamber vault loot) have a high chance to overwrite this datapack's loot tables, so the only vanilla method of obtaining aerodynamic enchanted books that would remain is through librarian villagers
- Datapacks that modify happy ghast's flying speed attribute will be compatible since this datapack applies a modifier to the attribute that adds onto it rather than modifying the base attribute directly
- All other datapacks that don't fall into either of the above two categories are compatible
